item.title: Trump Tells Senators to Pass the SAVE America Act ‘for Jesus’

item.description: As gas taxes rise nationwide, California leads with the steepest costs. Experts say EVs and environmental rules are driving prices higher.

item.title: 2 Democrats Side With Republicans to Confirm Mullin for DHS Secretary

item.description: Mobile billboards are being deployed at the three Washington, D.C.-area airports amid the DHS shutdown that has led to long TSA lines.
